text: This report discusses the impact of excluding amortization expenses, post-employment benefits expenses, and Solid Waste landfill closure and post-closure expenses from the 2018 Operating Budget. Ontario Regulation 286/09 "Budget Matters – Expenses" requires that the City prepare a report, prior to adoption of its budget, detailing amortization, post-employment benefits and landfill closure and post-closure expenses, if excluded from the budget. It also requires that the City adopt the report by resolution. Consistent with prior years, the City's 2018 Operating and Capital budgets have been prepared on the modified cash basis and therefore exclude the expenses listed above.
The Budget Committee recommends to the Executive Committee that: 1. City Council receive the report from the Interim Chief Financial Officer (January 8, 2018) for information.
